title: H5: 48h signal check for the EC CSV-converter market test (X engagement/profile-clicks/inbound, tool-page funnel), decide 10/20
detail: NEW MOTION follow-up (10/18 L4 checkpoint). By 2026-10-20, the Founder reads the H5 market-test signal: the Day-18 tool post tweet 2111479487422505053 (CTA self-reply 2111479489179881659 carries the tool link) — impressions / user_profile_clicks / replies (social/2026-10/metrics.json), any inbound inquiry on X or the Coconala gig, and whether the note article (h5-ec-csv-tool-note-1018) drew any response. signal_48h target = >=1 of {inbound inquiry about the tool/custom setup, X profile_click->contact, >=5 engaged impressions on the tool post vs median 12}. If >=1 real inquiry -> Art.10 act end-to-end <=12h (free first-win setup to break cold-start), book qualified_reach/sales conversation. If 0 after 48h -> this is the LAST AI-reachable buyer channel inside the current set; the 10/22 weekly review must carry the L5/E2 analysis (is any AI-reachable buyer channel left?). Do NOT pre-build the paid product before a signal (Art.5.5). Record the verdict in the 10/20 decision report. | RE-TARGETED 2026-10-18 12:50 (owner WHO/PAIN rule; decision 2026-10-18T1250 checkpoint_1018_amendment): WHO = 従業員0〜3名のBASE/STORES/メルカリShops店主・発送兼任スタッフが、発送日ごと(週2〜5回、1回10〜40件)に注文CSVをクリックポスト/ヤマトB2/ゆうプリRの取込形式へExcelで手直ししている。PAIN = 1回30〜60分(週1〜4時間)、取込エラーの1件ずつ修正、列ズレによる誤出荷。Lead with that moment and those numbers; no abstract wording (効率化/AI活用). | FUNNEL VERIFIED 2026-10-18T20:07 (founder, decision 2026-10-18T2007): the full reach→tool→CTA funnel is live and coherent — note nbed12c976efb published 13:21 JST links the tool; tool core logic adversarially re-read and correct (robust CSV parse incl. quotes/CRLF/tab/BOM; shipping-vs-billing auto-map; zip/zenkaku/様 normalization; free-text output columns keyword-mapped; FAQ/CTA copy promises only 参考プリセット+自由編集, never a guaranteed カート/送り状 fit) → the reach test will NOT false-negative on a broken tool. MEASUREMENT NOTE for this 10/20 read: there is NO tool-page analytics (GitHub Pages serves no view counts; adding a 3rd-party tracker needs an account = Art.9 and undercuts the 登録不要 pitch), so read the 'tool-page funnel' sub-signal via PROXIES only — note nbed12c976efb view count (mac-local headed), X post 2111479487422505053 impressions/user_profile_clicks (metrics.json), and any inbound inquiry on X/Coconala/note — NOT raw page hits. GAP for post-signal only: no ゆうプリR output preset (free-text covers it; add a preset only if a ゆうプリR signal appears — Art.5.4 bars it pre-signal). | RUNBOOK 2026-10-19 (founder, Day-19 08:07): on ANY inbound (here or earlier, any fire) execute marketing/2026-10/h5/FIRST_WIN_RUNBOOK.md — intake (sample CSV + their 送り状 service), build (reuse tool + add their preset), deliver free + honest verify, then the single review ask; SLA first reply ≤2h / free deliverable ≤12h; objective = first review (cold-start unlock), not revenue; on first win Art.7 double-down ≤24h.
